Re: Example Corp

Dear Jane Roe:

We have limited our review of your filing to the financial statements and
related disclosures and have the following comment.

Note 16. Revision of Previously Issued Financial Statements, page 33

1.     Please tell us further details of the error, including who identified

concluded internal control over financial reporting remained effective
notwithstanding the material weakness.
